proxy.how: A Cordis plugin: assistant/message shows each message as it ends, turn/end shows the reply, approval/request asks on the resident while the dsh UI asks too, and what the user writes steers the session through the Web or Desktop app's session controller.

docs.summary: Add @pixling/dsh-proxy to DeepSeek Harness: replies show on the resident, approvals are asked there, and what you write steers the session.
